bug_description.original: Use-of-uninitialized-value in UA_WorkQueue_manuallyProcessDelayed called from UA_WorkQueue_cleanup <- UA_Server_delete. Uninitialized value created by heap deallocation (cfree) inside UA_WorkQueue_manuallyProcessDelayed called from UA_WorkQueue_cleanup <- UA_Server_run_shutdown.
bug_description.normalized: When a SecureChannel is closed during message processing, removeSecureChannel defers ALL of UA_SecureChannel_deleteMembersCleanup (including connection detachment, session unlinking, and channel state update) to a delayed work queue callback. During server shutdown, UA_WorkQueue_manuallyProcessDelayed processes the deferred callback and UA_free(dc) frees the channel_entry (since the embedded cleanupCallback is the first field of channel_entry, UA_free(&entry->cleanupCallback) frees the entire struct). A subsequent call to UA_WorkQueue_manuallyProcessDelayed from UA_Server_delete reads from the freed memory, triggering a use-of-uninitialized-value. The fix splits deleteMembersCleanup into close() (synchronous: state=CLOSED, detach connection, unlink sessions) and deleteMembers() (deferrable: free certificates, nonces, tokens, messages).

source.description: First project-code statement that reads fuzzed binary data into a structured message header whose type field (OPN) dispatches into channel creation and the vulnerable deferred-cleanup path.
source.value_from: untrusted fuzz input (data, size) passed via UA_Server_processBinaryMessage
source.note: Decodes the message type from fuzzed data. The messageTypeAndChunkType field dispatches to OPN handling, which creates a secure channel and processes the message — entering the vulnerable deferred-cleanup path.

root_cause.description: Defers entire SecureChannel cleanup to a delayed callback, including state update, connection detachment, and session unlinking that must happen synchronously. Without immediate close, the freed callback memory is later read during a second work queue drain.
root_cause.note: Defers ALL channel cleanup — including setting channel state to CLOSED, detaching the connection, and unlinking sessions — to a delayed callback. The fix calls UA_SecureChannel_close() immediately here (which sets state=CLOSED, detaches connection, unlinks sessions) and defers only UA_SecureChannel_deleteMembers(). Without the synchronous close, the work queue inherits a dangling callback whose host allocation (channel_entry) is freed during shutdown processing and then re-read.

sink.description: Reads the next linked-list pointer from heap memory freed during a prior UA_WorkQueue_manuallyProcessDelayed invocation. MSan detects use-of-uninitialized-value.
sink.note: During the second call to UA_WorkQueue_manuallyProcessDelayed (from UA_Server_delete → UA_WorkQueue_cleanup), the linked list iteration reads the next field from memory that was freed by UA_free(dc) at line 255 during the first call (from UA_Server_run_shutdown). MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value because the freed heap memory is poisoned.

tainted_value_origin.note: The fuzzed binary data is decoded into a message header; the message type (OPN) determines the code path that creates a secure channel and triggers the vulnerable deferred-cleanup flow.

coarse_trace.summary: Decode message type from fuzzed data, dispatch to OPN handler which creates a secure channel and processes the message.
Allocate channel_entry (with embedded cleanupCallback as first field) and initialize the secure channel.
Process the decoded message; if processing fails, call Service_CloseSecureChannel which invokes removeSecureChannel.
Remove entry from channel list and defer ALL cleanup (including state update, connection detach, session unlink) to a delayed work queue callback.

During UA_Server_run_shutdown, process the deferred cleanup callback — deleteMembersCleanup runs, then UA_free(dc) frees the channel_entry. During UA_Server_delete, a second iteration reads from the freed memory: use-of-uninitialized-value.

fine_trace.note: Decodes message header from the fuzzed binary data. The messageTypeAndChunkType field yields UA_MESSAGETYPE_OPN, dispatching into the OPN handler that creates a secure channel.

Allocates the channel_entry struct. The first field is UA_DelayedCallback cleanupCallback, so &entry->cleanupCallback == entry. This allocation will later be freed by UA_free(dc) in the work queue processor.
Decrypts and adds the OPN chunk to the newly created channel. On success, the message is queued for processing.
Message processing fails (retval != GOOD). processSecureChannelMessage calls Service_CloseSecureChannel, which calls UA_SecureChannelManager_close → removeSecureChannel.

Enqueues the embedded cleanupCallback (= removeSecureChannelCallback → UA_SecureChannel_deleteMembersCleanup) as a delayed work queue callback. The channel state is NOT set to CLOSED, the connection is NOT detached, and sessions are NOT unlinked at this point. The fix adds UA_SecureChannel_close(&entry->channel) before this call, which synchronously sets state=CLOSED, detaches the connection, and unlinks sessions.

After message processing returns, UA_Server_processBinaryMessage continues to use connection->channel because the connection was not detached (cleanup was deferred). The fix adds a check: if(channel->state == UA_SECURECHANNELSTATE_CLOSED) return; before this call.

During UA_Server_run_shutdown → UA_WorkQueue_cleanup (ua_server.c:553), the deferred callback is processed: removeSecureChannelCallback runs UA_SecureChannel_deleteMembersCleanup, then UA_free(dc) frees the channel_entry (dc == &entry->cleanupCallback == entry). This heap deallocation makes the memory uninitialized under MSan.

During UA_Server_delete → UA_WorkQueue_cleanup (ua_server.c:218), the SIMPLEQ linked list iteration reads the next field from memory freed at step 7. MSan reports use-of-uninitialized-value. The uninitialized value was created by cfree at ua_workqueue.c:255.

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: N/A — CWE-457 uninitialized value from heap deallocation, not an allocation-site bug

poc.trigger: The PoC binary is processed by UA_Server_processBinaryMessage as an OPC UA message. It triggers secure channel creation (OPN) followed by a message processing error that closes the channel via removeSecureChannel, deferring ALL cleanup to a work queue callback. During server shutdown and deletion, the deferred callback runs (freeing the channel_entry), then a second work queue cleanup reads from the freed memory.

format.name: OPC UA binary protocol message
format.contract: A binary blob interpretable as an OPC UA wire protocol message (starting with a TcpMessageHeader) that triggers OPN channel creation and a subsequent processing error leading to Service_CloseSecureChannel. The exact content encodes an OPN message header followed by payload that causes processOPN or processSecureChannelMessage to fail.
